Laminate Wood Floor

Stylish. Durable. Affordable.

01

Overview

About Laminate Wood Floor

Laminate gives you a wood look at a friendly price. A tough wear layer protects the print from scratches and daily traffic, and the matt finishes suit modern, minimal rooms.

Premium matt finishes and elegant wood designs for modern interiors, with a tough surface that resists daily wear.

Enquire about thisSee all types

Types & quality

Choose the right Laminate Wood Floor

Swatches are digital renderings that show the look of each type. The real product's colour and finish can vary a little.

Homes

Natural oak decor

A printed oak-look surface under a tough wear layer, the most versatile shade. Choose AC3 for homes and AC4 or AC5 for busy areas.

Best for: Homes, rentals

Living rooms

Dark walnut decor

A deep brown print for a premium look. Dark colours show dust more, so regular sweeping helps.

Best for: Living rooms, offices

Apartments

Grey oak decor

A modern cool-grey tone that suits minimalist interiors.

Best for: Apartments, showrooms

Small rooms

White-wash decor

A light, airy finish that makes rooms look bigger.

Best for: Small rooms, bright interiors

Made from & benefits

What Laminate Wood Floor is made of

Laminate is built in layers: a fibreboard core, a printed wood-look paper and a hard transparent top layer, all pressed together.

High-density fibreboard corePrinted decor paperClear wear layerBacking layer

Scratch resistant

The wear layer protects the print.

Easy to clean

Sweep and wipe with a slightly damp mop.

Budget friendly

Costs less than real wood.

Quick to fit

Click-lock planks float over the subfloor.

07

Material guide

Know your material

What it is

Laminate is a floating floor with a high-density fibreboard core, a printed wood-look layer and a clear wear layer.

How it is made

The layers are fused under heat and pressure, then cut into planks with click-lock edges.

Installation tip

Lay over underlay on a flat, dry floor and keep a small expansion gap at the walls.

Strengths

  • Affordable and quick to install
  • Resists scratches and fading
  • Wide choice of wood looks

Good to know

  • Not suitable for wet areas
  • Cannot be sanded or refinished
08

FAQ

Common questions

How long does laminate last?

With normal care it can last many years. Check the wear class when buying.

Can it go over old tiles?

Often yes, if the tiles are flat and firmly fixed. Level any uneven joints first.
